sections.heading: EPDM for Bloomfield Commercial Properties: Benefits and Downsides

runs.v: EPDM is a reliable commercial roofing material with exceptional durability and weather resistance: it resists ozone, UV exposure, and thermal shock, stays resilient through freezing winters and hot summers, and stretches and recovers through freeze-thaw cycles. Wide sheets mean fewer seams and superior waterproofing, and EPDM is lightweight, cost-effective next to other materials, and often described as highly recyclable at the end of its service life. EPDM and TPO lead flat roofing for commercial buildings; asphalt shingles, slate, and metal cover pitched roofs.

seams depend on adhesive and splice tape, the membrane can shrink, and foot traffic around rooftop equipment can puncture it, though thicker EPDM (45, 60, and 90 mil are common) resists punctures better. Black EPDM absorbs heat, trimming winter heating costs but raising summer cooling costs, while white EPDM reflects UV rays and reflective options manage solar heat gain for energy efficiency; with careful attention to seams, walkways, and flashings, EPDM roofing systems on residential and commercial properties deliver long-term value on commercial flat roofing.

faqs.q: How long does an EPDM roof last on a Bloomfield commercial building?

runs.v: EPDM rubber membrane lasts 15 to 25 years, per the InterNACHI life-expectancy chart, and a properly maintained EPDM roof is often cited at 25 to 30 years; seam separation is the failure mode that ends its service, per NRCA technical guidance, so annual inspections, drain cleaning, and prompt seam repair carry it toward the top of that range.

faqs.q: Do you need a permit for a commercial EPDM roof in Bloomfield, NJ?

runs.v: Yes, once the work exceeds 25% of the roof area in 12 months on a commercial, multi-family, or attached building, per N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7; confirm the scope with the Township of Bloomfield construction office. A detached one- or two-family flat-roof section counts as ordinary maintenance.

faqs.q: When should a Bloomfield EPDM roof be replaced instead of repaired?

runs.v: Consider a complete replacement when membrane damage exceeds roughly 25 to 30% of the roof area, when leaks recur at the same spot, or when the membrane reaches 15 to 25 years, per Modernize, HomeGuide, and HomeAdvisor flat-roof guidance; below that, seam and flashing roof repairs restore it.
